scope: Conversation-derived project proposal, owner authorization, project isolation and construction through intake acceptance
sourcePolicy: Observed fields are allowlisted. Session labels are per-run aliases. Text prompts, plan bodies, credentials, machine paths, provider request identifiers and raw DOM or event payloads are excluded.
usagePolicy: Native response usage only. Input is uncached input. Prompt totals add input, cache reads and cache writes. Failed requests without reported usage are excluded from totals. Synthetic counts describe only loopback fixtures.

continuation after UI reload retains the native session ID and reuses the existing private project
a preconfigured real workspace retains its original authority bytes and does not create a shadow project
